sonnet.review: MAUI 'new_page' URL shows the full local file:// simulator path; C++ shows 'https://demo.test/welcome' — different URL display but functionally equivalent page content · Both show 'Welcome', 'Served from a static HtmlWebViewSource.' subtitle, and the same navigation buttons (Page A, Page B, Back, Forward, Reload, Eval 1+1) · C++ buttons are more spread out / larger tap targets; MAUI buttons are more compact/centered · Both dark modes show the same page content with the same URL difference and button spacing

gemini.review: The C++ implementation displays a significantly shorter URL string compared to the MAUI reference. · The vertical spacing between the buttons and the text elements is inconsistent between the two implementations. · The alignment of the button group relative to the left margin differs, with the C++ version appearing more centered than the MAUI version.

sonnet.review: WebView content text differs: MAUI shows 'Served from a static HtmlWebViewSource.' + nav status line; C++ shows 'No navigation yet' placeholder instead.

sonnet_cpp.review: Both themes: button ORDER and count match MAUI (Page A, Page B, Back, Forward, Reload, Eval 1+1) and the two status lines are in the right place. Two clear bugs: (1) WRONG TEXT on the first status line — cpp renders 'No navigation yet' where MAUI renders 'new_page -> about:blank' (the WebView Navigated event/state is not reflected). 'Eval result: <none>' matches. (2) Button chrome drift — MAUI draws clearly outlined rounded buttons with a visible 1px border; cpp buttons are much flatter with near-invisible borders (very faint in light, low-contrast fill in dark), so the buttons read as pale bars rather than MAUI's crisp outlined buttons. Content/order otherwise correct; the wrong status text is the red-level defect.

sonnet_xaml.review: Both themes: button order and count match MAUI and the button chrome (crisp rounded outlined buttons) is closer to MAUI than cpp. But two defects: (1) WRONG TEXT on the first status line — xaml renders 'new_page -> https://demo.test/welcome' where MAUI renders 'new_page -> about:blank' (wrong navigation URL shown). 'Eval result: <none>' matches. (2) LAYOUT — a large empty surface occupies roughly the top third of the page ABOVE the status labels, pushing the label+button block far down; MAUI has the labels at the very top with no blank region above them. This is not the outer page-inset (it is a big internal empty block above the content, not a uniform margin) and reads as a stray/blank WebView area or wrong vertical layout. Together the wrong URL text and the pushed-down content are red-level defects.
